tokens.name: surface-base
tokens.usage: Default ground: the bar, window backgrounds, the launcher.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Panels, popups, notification cards and anything that sits one step above the base.

tokens.name: surface-overlay
tokens.usage: Menus, tooltips and dropdowns that float over raised surfaces.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells: input and search fields, slider tracks, code blocks.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for rows, list items and ghost buttons on any surface.

tokens.name: surface-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed fill for ghost and secondary buttons, rows and list items. Text on it is `text-primary` or `text-secondary`.

tokens.name: surface-selected
tokens.usage: The selected segment or thumb sitting in a `surface-sunken` well (segmented controls, switches). Text on it is `text-primary`.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: The dimmed layer behind dialogs and the power menu. Nothing is placed directly on it except the dialog.

tokens.name: glass-base
tokens.usage: The bar's fill when transparency is on: `surface-base` at the glass opacity (`opacity-glass`, 80%), over a `blur-glass` backdrop blur. The real alpha follows the person's bar opacity setting.

tokens.name: glass-raised
tokens.usage: The dock's and the lock-screen card's fill when transparency is on: `surface-raised` at the glass opacity.

tokens.name: glass-border
tokens.usage: Replaces `border-subtle` inside glass: the outline of the bar and dock and the lines between their parts. Stays visible over any wallpaper.

tokens.name: glass-hover
tokens.usage: Replaces `surface-hover` inside glass, so hovered modules tint the glass instead of covering it.

tokens.name: glass-pressed
tokens.usage: Replaces `surface-pressed` inside glass: pressed items and open popups' modules.

tokens.name: glass-accent
tokens.usage: Replaces `accent-text` inside glass: accent text and glyphs (the focused app's name, the updates and notification glyphs). Holds 4.5:1 at 80% glass over any wallpaper.

tokens.name: border-subtle
tokens.usage: Dividers and the 1px outline of panels and cards. Decorative only; never the only thing marking a control.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Outlines of inputs, switches, checkboxes and other controls (3:1 on every surface).

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Body copy and titles on every `surface-*` token.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Supporting text (subtitles, timestamps, app names) on every `surface-*` token.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Placeholders and hints on every `surface-*` token (still 4.5:1). Disabled text uses `text-disabled`.

tokens.name: text-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled labels only. Deliberately below 4.5:1, as WCAG allows for inactive controls.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Primary action fill, active workspace, switch-on track, slider fill. Text on it is `on-accent`.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover state of `accent` fills.

tokens.name: accent-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed state of `accent` fills.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `accent`, `accent-hover` and `accent-pressed` in both themes.

tokens.name: accent-subtle
tokens.usage: Selected row, active list item or tinted badge ground. Text on it is `accent-text` or `text-primary`.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Links, active tab labels and accent icons on `surface-*` and `accent-subtle`.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: The 1px keyboard focus ring, drawn 1px outside buttons, tags and other controls. Text fields, selects and other boxed inputs turn their own 1px border this color instead. Solid, never glowing; 3:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success: text, icons and solid fills. As text it sits on `surface-*` and `success-subtle`; always pair it with an icon or word, never color alone.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning (orange, so it never reads as the brand gold): text, icons and solid fills. As text it sits on `surface-*` and `warning-subtle`; always pair it with an icon or word, never color alone.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Danger and errors: text, icons and solid fills. As text it sits on `surface-*` and `danger-subtle`; always pair it with an icon or word, never color alone.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Informational: text, icons and solid fills. As text it sits on `surface-*` and `info-subtle`; always pair it with an icon or word, never color alone.

tokens.name: success-subtle
tokens.usage: Tinted ground for success banners and badges; text on it is `success`.

tokens.name: warning-subtle
tokens.usage: Tinted ground for warning banners and badges; text on it is `warning`.

tokens.name: danger-subtle
tokens.usage: Tinted ground for danger banners and badges; text on it is `danger`.

tokens.name: info-subtle
tokens.usage: Tinted ground for info banners and badges; text on it is `info`.

tokens.name: on-status
tokens.usage: Text and icons on solid `success`, `warning`, `danger` and `info` fills (for example the notification count badge).

groups.title: Font weight
groups.note: Geist ships as a variable font, so every weight from 100 to 900 is available in upright and italic. Interface text uses 400–600.

tokens.name: font-weight-thin
tokens.usage: Very large decorative numbers only (36px and up).

tokens.name: font-weight-extralight
tokens.usage: Very large decorative numbers only (36px and up).

tokens.name: font-weight-light
tokens.usage: Large display text on wallpapers and the lock screen.

tokens.name: font-weight-regular
tokens.usage: Body text, captions, code.

tokens.name: font-weight-medium
tokens.usage: Labels, button text, `display`, emphasis in body text.

tokens.name: font-weight-semibold
tokens.usage: All headings (`h1`–`h4`), `overline`, highlighted code.

tokens.name: font-weight-bold
tokens.usage: Rare: short marketing-style headlines in the installer. Not for interface text.

tokens.name: font-weight-extrabold
tokens.usage: Not used in the interface; available for branding and artwork.

tokens.name: font-weight-black
tokens.usage: Not used in the interface; available for branding and artwork.

groups.title: Letter spacing
groups.note: Large text tightens slightly; small capitals open up.

tokens.name: tracking-tightest
tokens.usage: `display-xl`, and `display-lg` at -0.025em.

tokens.name: tracking-tighter
tokens.usage: `display` and `h1`.

tokens.name: tracking-normal
tokens.usage: Everything at 15px and below.

tokens.name: tracking-wide
tokens.usage: `overline` and any other all-capitals text.

groups.title: Spacing
groups.note: Compact first. Inside controls use 2 to 8px; 16px and up separates groups and sections. Keep spacing symmetric on opposite sides.

tokens.name: space-xxs
tokens.usage: Gap between an icon and a badge; padding inside small chips.

tokens.name: space-xs
tokens.usage: Default control padding and the gap between an icon and its label.

tokens.name: space-s
tokens.usage: Padding inside panels and cards, gap between list rows and bar modules.

tokens.name: space-md
tokens.usage: Gap between groups inside a panel; dialog padding.

tokens.name: space-lg
tokens.usage: Separation between page sections in settings and the installer.

tokens.name: space-xl
tokens.usage: Large empty-state and lock-screen breathing room.

groups.title: Radius
groups.note: Soft rounding. Nested corners step down so the gap stays even: an 8px control inside a 10px panel.

tokens.name: slight
tokens.usage: Chips, tooltips, checkboxes, small tags.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: List rows, menu items and bar modules.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Inputs, switches, buttons and any form control.

tokens.name: rounded
tokens.usage: Panels, popups, cards, dialogs and notifications.

tokens.name: fully-rounded
tokens.usage: Badges on notification icons and pill tags. Size them with padding, not a fixed width and height.

groups.title: Shadow
groups.note: Nothing is shiny. Surfaces separate with color and 1px borders. Shadows are short and tight, never a wide soft haze.

tokens.name: shadow-none
tokens.usage: Default for every surface, including cards and the bar.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Pressed-in depth for tooltips and small floating chips.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Menus, popups and notifications that float over other windows. Always with a `border-subtle` outline.

groups.title: Gradient
groups.note: Gradients are slight: two close tones of the same color, so they read as depth rather than color. Never on text or small controls.

tokens.name: gradient-ewellow
tokens.usage: Large accent areas: the installer hero, the About page banner. Text on it is `on-accent`.

tokens.name: gradient-ember
tokens.usage: Default wallpaper and lock-screen background: near-black with a faint warm tint.

tokens.name: gradient-night
tokens.usage: Dark-theme panel and launcher backgrounds that want a little depth.

tokens.name: gradient-glow
tokens.usage: A barely visible warm light at the top of dark panels (quick settings, launcher). Layer it over `surface-raised`.

tokens.name: border-width-1
tokens.usage: Every outline and divider by default, and the focus ring.

tokens.name: border-width-2
tokens.usage: The active workspace indicator, selected-state outlines and the bottom edge of keycaps.

tokens.name: focus-width
tokens.usage: Width of the focus ring on every control. Increase contrast raises it to 2px; the stroke preset never changes it.

tokens.name: field-border-width
tokens.usage: Fields, checkboxes and switches: their outline, which stays at 1px when the stroke preset is none, follows thick up, and is 2px under Increase contrast. An ewe addition, not in tokens.json yet.

groups.title: Size
groups.note: Sizes for controls, the bar, icons, panels and windows. Small steps keep panels compact; the larger steps are for the bar, launcher and installer.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons, chips and compact rows.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default height for buttons, inputs, switches and menu rows.

tokens.name: control-lg

tokens.name: control-xl

tokens.name: control-2xl
tokens.usage: Installer buttons and fields, launcher result rows, large touch targets.

tokens.name: bar-height

tokens.name: bar-height-lg
tokens.usage: Roomier bar option, for large or high-resolution screens and dock-style layouts.

tokens.name: icon-xs
tokens.usage: Icons inside badges, checkbox checks and switch thumbs. Drawn with a fixed 1.5px stroke.

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: Icons inside `caption` and `label` text.

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: Default icon size in buttons, menus and list rows.

tokens.name: icon-lg
tokens.usage: Bar module icons in `bar-height`; notification action icons.

tokens.name: icon-xl
tokens.usage: Bar module icons in `bar-height-lg`; app icons in notifications and the tray.

tokens.name: icon-2xl
tokens.usage: App icons in launcher result rows and the window switcher.

tokens.name: icon-3xl
tokens.usage: App icons in the launcher grid; empty-state illustrations.

tokens.name: icon-4xl
tokens.usage: Large app icons on the About page, installer and app details.

tokens.name: panel-sm
tokens.usage: Quick settings, notification banners, the volume and brightness popup, the media player.

tokens.name: panel-md
tokens.usage: Dialogs, the notification center and other side sheets, popovers with forms.

tokens.name: panel-lg
tokens.usage: The launcher, large dialogs and the power menu row.

tokens.name: window-gap
tokens.usage: Hyprland gaps: 8px between windows and around the screen edge (gaps_in 4, gaps_out 8). Windows use the `rounded` radius and a `border-width-2` border.

tokens.name: blur-glass
tokens.usage: The backdrop blur behind glass surfaces. Hyprland's blur size 6 with 3 passes gives about this radius.

groups.title: Opacity
groups.note: How opaque surfaces and windows are. The bar and dock follow the person's bar opacity setting (0–100); these are the fixed reference points.

tokens.name: opacity-solid
tokens.usage: The default for the bar and dock (bar opacity 100): solid, no blur.

tokens.name: opacity-glass
tokens.usage: The glass preset for the bar, dock and lock-screen card, with `blur-glass` behind. The lowest opacity at which text and glyphs keep their contrast over any wallpaper.

tokens.name: opacity-app
tokens.usage: All windows when app blur is on. Fullscreen windows stay solid.

tokens.name: opacity-inactive
tokens.usage: Unfocused windows when window transparency is on. The focused window stays solid.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: The lock screen clock. Light weight keeps a large size calm.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Installer welcome and lock screen date.

styles.name: display

styles.name: overline

styles.name: mono

motion.name: fast

motion.usage: The screen dimming before it locks
